implementation.targetScope: Lazy initialization and assignment of ordinary object properties. Shared value installation avoids an additional per-property closure; subsequent reads use normal data properties.

differences: Dual CJS/ESM entry points support the installed CommonJS opener and current ESM opener.
Declarations also cover symbol and numeric property keys already accepted at runtime.
Inherited accessors intentionally update the defining object, matching upstream; initializer failures retry on the next read.
No opener rewrite, command launching, public release or application adoption is claimed.
